$description: Go Vocal design tokens (DTCG 2025.10): every --gv-* custom property in src/tokens.css, with its value, what it is for and its Figma variable id. Generated by npm run tokens:build from tokens/; do not edit. Paint with the semantic groups (surface, text, icon, border), never with color.*; docs/NAMING.md "Token names" has the grammar.

2.$description: A hairline gap: between an icon and its badge, stacked lines of a label.

4.$description: A tight gap: inside small controls, between an icon and its text in a pill.

6.$description: A small gap: a popover's padding, icon to label in a button.

8.$description: The default small gap: between controls in a row, a menu item's padding.

10.$description: A control's inline padding: fields, Select, a toolbar.

12.$description: The default gap inside a card or row; a Button's inline padding.

16.$description: A panel's padding; the gap between rows of controls.

20.$description: A card's padding; the gap between groups in a form.

24.$description: A panel's or modal's padding; the gap between sections.

32.$description: The gap between page sections; a page's padding.

40.$description: A section's padding on a page, an empty state's room.

48.$description: A large page gap: around an empty state, between page regions.

56.$description: A very large gap: a page header's room.

64.$description: Not in Figma, unused for now: the next step on the ladder, so it has no hole.

104.$description: Title field's clear zone (on the 8 grid).

2.$description: The smallest corner: a focus ring around text, a tiny mark.

4.$description: A small corner: a Checkbox, a tag, a tooltip.

6.$description: A compact control's corner: a small icon button, a toast's ×.

8.$description: The default corner: buttons, fields, menus, rows, cards inside a panel.

10.$description: Figma's control radius for larger controls.

12.$description: A container's corner: panels, popovers, cards, toasts.

22.$description: The phone preview's corner (a drawing, not UI).

full.$description: A pill or a circle: badges, avatars, dots, a Switch.

stat.$description: Big numbers: KPI tiles, stat rows. 28/32 Regular.

stat-small.$description: Small number tiles and counts in rows. 20/24 Medium.

title.$description: Panel, modal and dashboard card titles. 16/24 Medium.

body-strong.$description: Emphasised body: an alert dialog's title, a metric's label. 14/20 Medium.

body.$description: Reading text: metric labels, banners, descriptions. 14/20 Regular.

ui-strong.$description: Buttons, the current breadcrumb, a selected segment, a row's title. 13/20 Medium.

ui.$description: The control text: list rows, cells, menu options, breadcrumbs, group titles. 13/20 Regular.

small-strong.$description: Pills, the rail header, a phase name, a sorted column header. 12/16 Medium.

small.$description: Captions and meta: card titles, To review and Required, rail labels. 12/16 Regular.

document-display.$description: Not in Figma: a document's title on its title page (a report's cover). 44/52 Medium.

document-heading.$description: Not in Figma: a document's section heading on its page (a report's numbered section). 28/36 Medium.

document-lead.$description: Not in Figma: a document's lead line: the title page's subtitle, a figure's finding, an insight's question. 19/28 Regular.

document-body.$description: Not in Figma: a document's reading text on its page (a report's paragraphs and lists, a quote's words). 13/20 Regular.

raised-strong.$description: A raised shape a step stronger: the selected item of a Segmented control.

raised.$description: Something that rests on a surface: a card, a menu, a popover, a selected segment's rest state.

overlay.$description: Something that floats over the page: a modal, the side panel, a dialog.

app.$description: The page behind everything: the back office's background around panels.

panel.$description: The default surface: panels, cards, menus, popovers, fields, modals. White.

tertiary.$description: A light grey stage under a group of panels or specimens: a phone preview's backdrop, the Foundations specimens. Same value as surface-hovered; pick by meaning.

secondary.$description: A surface a step off white, inside a panel: a modal's footer, a drop zone, a stat card, a toolbar.

hovered.$description: A neutral row, item or quiet button under the pointer (data-hovered). Same value as surface-tertiary; pick by meaning.

pressed.$description: A neutral row, item or quiet button pressed (data-pressed); also an open trigger, the current tree item and a selected list item. Same value as surface-app and surface-neutral; pick by meaning.

info.$description: An info tint: an info Badge or Banner, a drop target, the AI tint. Text on it is text-info, icons icon-info.

backdrop.$description: The scrim behind a modal dialog.

neutral.$description: The neutral tint of a pill or track: a Badge, a Segmented control's track, a meter's empty track, a pill Select, an avatar with no picture. Text on it is text-neutral.

accent-strong.$description: The solid accent fill of a measure: a meter's or progress bar's value, vote progress.

success.$description: A success tint: a success Toast, a live status. Text on it is text-success-strong.

brand-strong.$description: The solid brand fill: a primary Button, a coachmark, the current page in Pagination, an avatar's initials. Text on it is text-inverse.

selected-strong.$description: The solid fill of something checked or selected: a checked Checkbox, a selected menu box, a selected tag or token, a focused date segment. Text and ticks on it are inverse.

inverse.$description: The near-black fill that inverts the page: a Switch that is on, a selected toggle button. Text and icons on it are text-inverse and icon-inverse.

neutral-strong.$description: The solid neutral fill: a Switch that is off, an upcoming phase's dot.

danger-strong.$description: The solid danger fill: a danger Button, the New dot, a count of new items, an invalid Switch.

document.$description: Not in Figma: the paper of a document people read or print: a report's sheet on the Page stage, resting on surface-tertiary with shadow-raised. White, the panel's value; a platform's theme may set its own paper with its document face (font-family-document).

selected.$description: A selected row, cell or range: the brand at 10% over the panel. Rows, list rows, the data table, the range calendar.

neutral-hovered.$description: A neutral fill under the pointer: a pill-shaped Select or chip hovered.

danger.$description: A danger tint: the alert dialog's icon badge, a quiet danger button hovered.

danger-pressed.$description: The danger tint pressed: a quiet danger button held down.

warning.$description: A warning tint: a warning Banner, the side panel's warning strip.

success-strong.$description: The solid success fill: the tick in a success Toast.

disabled.$description: A field or control that can't be used: a disabled Text field's fill.

surface.$description: Side nav only (component tier): its dark navy background.

surface-current.$description: Side nav only: the current item's background.

icon.$description: Side nav only: an item's icon.

icon-current.$description: Side nav only: the current item's icon.

icon-accent.$description: Side nav only (component tier): an icon in the accent green on the dark nav (the Support row).

border-focused.$description: Side nav only (component tier): the keyboard focus ring on the dark nav, where border-focused would vanish. Drawn as var(--gv-border-width-2) solid, inset.

primary.$description: The default text: headings, labels, values, everything that isn't secondary.

body.$description: Long reading text: paragraphs in a description, a comment, an official update.

secondary.$description: Supporting text: descriptions, meta, column headers, helper text.

tertiary.$description: The quietest readable text: counts beside a label, timestamps, a separator dot. Same value as text-placeholder; pick by meaning.

disabled.$description: Text in a control that can't be used.

neutral.$description: Text on surface-neutral: a neutral Badge, a Segmented control's items, a pill Select.

success-strong.$description: Success words on surface-success: a success Toast's title and action, a live status.

success.$description: Success words on the panel: reviewed, done.

inverse.$description: Text on a strong fill: surface-brand-strong, surface-inverse, surface-danger-strong.

placeholder.$description: A field's placeholder. Same value as text-tertiary; pick by meaning.

link.$description: A link's words. Hovered: text-link-hovered; pressed: text-link-pressed.

danger.$description: Danger words: a danger button's label, a field error, a negative trend, a count of new items that needs action.

info.$description: Info words on surface-info: an info Badge.

brand.$description: Brand words that are not links: "new" markers, ranks, badges, the current page number.

control.$description: The border of a field or control: Text field, Select, Checkbox, Radio, an outlined Button.

control-hovered.$description: A field or control's border under the pointer.

default.$description: The default border of a container: cards, menus, popovers, tables, tabs, panels, the side panel.

subtle.$description: A quiet line: a divider inside a panel, a list's separators.

row.$description: The faintest line: between table rows.

selected.$description: The edge of something selected or checked: a selected Choice card, a checked box, the current tab's line, a drop target.

inverse.$description: A ring that separates a shape from a busy or dark fill: overlapping avatars.

strong.$description: A neutral border a step darker than default: a Switch's edge, a Choice card, an empty state's dashed frame.

danger.$description: An invalid field or control's border.

warning.$description: The edge of a warning tint: the side panel's warning strip.

success.$description: The edge of a success tint: a success Toast and its action.

disabled.$description: The border of a control that can't be used.

accent.$description: The accent edge: an item a change added (an added Item chip), the edge of an assistant's entry in an Activity feed.

focused.$description: The keyboard focus ring's colour. Components draw the whole ring with --gv-focus-ring.

tertiary.$description: A quiet icon: a field's leading icon, a breadcrumb separator.

secondary.$description: An icon beside secondary text: the default in rows, menus and toolbars.

quiet.$description: The quietest icon: chevrons that open or move, a sort mark. A disabled icon is icon-disabled (same value).

primary.$description: An icon beside primary text, or one that is the main thing in its control.

inverse.$description: An icon on a strong fill (surface-brand-strong, surface-inverse, surface-danger-strong).

danger.$description: A danger icon: the alert dialog's badge, a danger button's icon.

brand.$description: A brand icon: a check in a selected option, a selected menu item's tick, an active filter's icon.

accent.$description: An accent mark: the spinner and the done ticks of a working assistant (Chat progress), the mark on what the assistant made.

disabled.$description: An icon in a control that can't be used.

highlight.$description: Chart: the one thing a finding names, in the accent: a highlighted bar, a highlighted figure (Stat tile's isHighlighted, a document's lead number). Not in Figma; the same teal as surface-accent-strong.

ring.$description: The keyboard focus ring: outline: var(--gv-focus-ring) on [data-focus-visible], with --gv-focus-ring-offset outside the box or --gv-focus-ring-offset-inset inside it.

ring-offset.$description: The focus ring's gap outside the box: outline-offset for anything with room around it.

ring-offset-inset.$description: The focus ring drawn inside the box: outline-offset for rows, tabs and cells that touch their neighbours.

1.$description: A hairline: borders, dividers, rows. Writing 1px is fine too; the token matches Figma's stroke variable.

2.$description: A strong stroke: the focus ring, a selected card's edge.

disabled.$description: Anything that can't be used, drawn at 45% (docs/DECISIONS.md).

dragging.$description: A row or item while it is dragged.

dimmed.$description: What steps back while another series is picked out: a legend item, a bar, a legend row.

sticky.$description: z-index of what sticks while its content scrolls: a table's header.

panel.$description: z-index of a non-modal panel over the page: the side panel.

overlay.$description: z-index of what floats over everything: modals, toasts.

family.$description: The one typeface. Every text style uses it; set it through a type role (font: var(--gv-type-<role>)), not on its own.

family-document.$description: Not in Figma: the typeface of a document people read or print (a report's pages), set through the document roles (font: var(--gv-type-document-<role>)). The interface's family by default; a platform's theme sets this one at :root to give its documents its own face while the interface keeps Public Sans.

size-12.$description: Small and Small strong: captions, meta, pills, labels.

size-13.$description: UI and UI strong: the control size (buttons, rows, menus, cells).

size-14.$description: Body and Body strong: reading text, modal titles.

size-16.$description: Title: panel, modal and card titles.

size-19.$description: Not in Figma: Document lead, a document's opening line and a figure's finding.

size-20.$description: Stat small: small number tiles and counts.

size-28.$description: Stat: big numbers in KPI tiles.

size-44.$description: Not in Figma: Document display, a document's title on its title page.

line-height-28.$description: Not in Figma: the line under 19px text.

line-height-36.$description: Not in Figma: the line under 28px document headings.

line-height-52.$description: Not in Figma: the line under 44px text.

weight-medium.$description: Medium (500): the strong roles and titles. To make a role's text medium: font-weight: var(--gv-font-weight-medium).

tracking.$description: The one letter spacing, 0px, set once on :root (theme.css) and inherited by every element and form control. No role tracks its own.

fast.$description: A change in place: hover, press and focus colours, fades, a chevron turning, a tooltip or menu appearing, a dialog leaving.

medium.$description: A short move or an entrance: an indicator or knob sliding, a tick drawing, a dialog or coachmark coming in.

slow.$description: A change of size or a long move: a panel opening, a tab panel resizing, a sheet or toast sliding, a bar filling.

loop.$description: One cycle of a repeating status: a skeleton pulsing, an indeterminate bar sweeping. Not shortened under reduced motion (a 1 ms loop flickers): the component stops it.

standard.$description: In place: colours, fades, a chevron turning, a press; and one transition that plays both ways (a popover in and out). CSS's ease, the prototype's default.

enter.$description: Something arriving: quick start, soft landing (a dialog, toast or card coming in).

exit.$description: Something leaving: soft start, quick finish (a dialog or toast going away). CSS's ease-in.

move.$description: Something travelling or resizing on screen: an indicator or knob sliding, a panel opening, a bar filling; and loops.

12.$description: The smallest glyph: a tag's remove ×, a tick in a small mark.

14.$description: Icons in dense rows and small controls: a disclosure chevron, a list row's marks, a filter chip's icon.

16.$description: The default icon: in buttons, icon buttons, menus, options, cards and fields.

18.$description: Navigation and status icons: the side nav, a search field's magnifier, a toast's status mark.

20.$description: A standalone icon with room around it: a modal's close ×, a drop zone, the icon gallery.

24.$description: The largest UI icon: an alert dialog's badge, an image placeholder, a side nav icon slot.
The smallest square button: a banner's or toast's dismiss ×, a rich text toolbar button.

28.$description: Compact controls: the default icon button, a modal's close, a card's chevron, a toast action, a toggle in a group.

32.$description: Small controls and rows: Button size 32, Compact button, Segmented control, menu, tree and list items.

36.$description: The default control: text, date and number fields, Select, the default Button, a side nav row. Fields line up with buttons beside them.

40.$description: Large controls: a field inside a card, a folded side nav item (a square hit area).

16.$description: A face inside a dense row: an assignee in a list row.

24.$description: Avatar groups (overlapping faces) and the side nav's account row.
